messages:
sam: quick sync on aging vs fixed-window coalesce after the weekend experiment. short requests p50 improved but we saw long-context p95 regressions.

ivy: timeline? which params were changed?

sam: set `aging_ms=10`, `max_coalesce_ms=25`. mixed chat + occasional long embeddings. p95 +130ms.

mike: likely ordering inversion: small requests getting dispatched early while preceding large requests wake KV later -> cold misses.

tara: can we expose a tiny "warmup_score" per-tenant from scheduler -> batcher? batcher can use it to bias aging locally. push model every 50ms so no sync in hot path.

sam: push model preferred. proposal: quantize score 0..3, mapped to warmup_prob ranges. batcher extends `aging_ms` by score*5ms.

ivy: add `ordering_skew` histogram to detect inversion; also `batcher.aging_delays` metric. low-cardinality tags.

mike: sim first. racy workloads can be reproduced with small trace harness. I'll add a replay that toggles long-request fraction.

infra-bot: canary kickoff blocked until warmup_score plumbing present. auto-rollback rule: p95_delta>50ms AND kv_miss_rate>0.1 -> rollback.

sam: action list: implement warmup_score push (mike), add ordering_skew + aging_delays metrics (ivy), sim harness (sam). timeline: PRs by Thu, small canary next week.

tara: note: for Dedicated deployments we may default to aggressive aging; add `deployment_type` tag.

sam: agreed. keep thread open for followups.
